articles.title: City Birds Fly Away Sooner From Women Than Men
articles.summary: In five European countries, city birds let men get about a meter closer than women before flying off.

articles.title: Mother Bats' Hearts Speed Up When They Hear Their Own Pups
articles.summary: A Japanese study found mother bats' heartbeats quicken when they hear calls from their own pups.

articles.title: Three British Players Reach Wrexham Open Quarter-Finals
articles.summary: Alicia Dudeney, Hannah Klugman and Jodie Burrage all reached the Wrexham Open quarter-finals.
